A helpful note, earlier this week
A focused finish is easier with a plan
Travelers should check pet papers, carrier fit, and handoff details before heading to the airport.

Aurelia Skyways keeps the Companion Animal Travel Desk moving with a simple routine. We review each booking for clear pet care notes, look over carrier setup, and flag anything that could slow boarding. This helps the welcome team stay ready and keeps the line calm for everyone.

If you are traveling with a pet, keep your documents easy to reach and make sure your carrier is secure and clean. Pets should be comfortable, and their space should allow safe movement without extra fuss. When you arrive, follow the desk guidance so the check-in process stays smooth and steady.

The safety coordinator also walks through common hazards and checks for preventable issues before pets are passed along for boarding. That extra attention helps reduce stress for travelers and animals alike, especially when plans shift or a pet needs a little more care. If you need support, come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk and we will help you sort it out.
